sys_app.name: JobPulse
sys_app.description: Scheduled Job Health & Overlap Monitor — inventory, score, and remediate every scheduled job in your instance before the next missed SLA.

role.name: x_jbpls.user
role.description: Can view health data, run scans, and export reports.

role.name: x_jbpls.admin
role.description: Full access: configure, disable/reschedule jobs, manage settings.

role.name: x_jbpls.cross_scope
role.description: Read-only access to OOTB tables (sys_trigger, sys_trigger_job, syslog, sys_scope, sys_db_object).
